verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Osborne Clarke's EC&VC team supports companies 'from incorporation through to exit', offers free cap table templates, and advises on employee incentives (EMI, growth shares). None of its materials in the pack cover founder vesting schedules, 83(b) or a local equivalent, or co-founder equity splits. These are adjacent offerings, not founder equity mechanics content, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's own materials cover founder equity mechanics — vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or the local equivalent, and equity splits among co-founders — so day-zero ownership is set up right
